title: Polished Chrome Toilet Paper Stand, 29-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Euro Toilet Tissue Holder, Carolina, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Polished Chrome, toilet paper stand for bathroom use, 29-inch freestanding floor stand made from solid brass with a European style hook for fast roll changes, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. Use as a toilet paper holder, toilet tissue stand, toilet roll holder, or bathroom toilet paper stand when wall space is limited and you want a no-drill solution. Traditional design with classic details; pairs with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Dimensions: 29 inches overall size; product measures 8 in L x 27 in H x 6 in W (29-inch, 29in). Heavy base helps prevent tipping. Includes toilet tissue stand; some assembly required. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Carolina collection, matching Carolina pieces available.
